Sorting algorithms

How do I sort a list in Python? Show me quicksort.

Here is a simple approach. See the docs.

def quicksort(xs):
    if len(xs) <= 1:
        return xs
    pivot = xs[0]
    rest = xs[1:]
    return quicksort([x for x in rest if x < pivot]) + [pivot] + quicksort([x for x in rest if x >= pivot])

That runs in O(n log n) on average.
